event.title: Former Wagner Commanders Allegedly Admit to Killing Civilians in Ukraine
event.canonical_title: Former Wagner Commanders Allegedly Admit to Killing Civilians in Ukraine
event.summary: Two Russian men claiming to be former commanders of the Wagner Group have reportedly confessed to killing children and civilians during their operations in Ukraine. This admission was made to a human rights activist, highlighting serious allegations of human rights violations associated with the group's activities.
